items.title: 9.9 Bairooni electric field se bachao (shielding) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.9 with Fig. 9.19 (PDF 207-208).

blocks.text: Angrez scientist Michael Faraday ne 1836 mein ek dhancha banaya jise Faraday cage ya Faraday shield kehte hain. Faraday cage conductor (dhaat) ka bana aisa ihata (enclosure) hai jo bahar ki electric fields ko andar nahi aane deta. Yeh khokhle (hollow) conductor ki tarah kaam karta hai jis ke andar aalaat ya cheezein bahar ki electric fields se bachane ke liye rakhi ja sakti hain. Cage ko lagne wala bijli ka jhatka (shock) us ki bahar wali surface se guzar jata hai aur andar nuqsan nahi karta. Khokhle conductor ke andar electric field zero rehti hai.

Faraday cage ka kaam samajhne ke liye maan lein conductor ke ek tukre (maslan copper) par kuch zaid (excess) free electrons hain. Har electron par padosi electrons ki field ki wajah se dhakelne wali (repulsive) force lagti hai. Nateeja: saare zaid electrons conductor ki surface par chale jate hain. Jab saara zaid charge surface par pohanch kar static equilibrium ban jaye to charge ki mazeed harkat ruk jati hai. Agar ragar (friction) waghaira se kuch electrons conductor se kisi aur cheez par chale jayein to conductor ki surface par net musbat charge reh jata hai. Is liye hum keh sakte hain:

blocks.title: Conductor par charge
blocks.text: Electrostatic halaat mein equilibrium par conductor ka har zaid charge us ki surface par rehta hai.
Ab khokhle conductor ke andar dekhein. Zaid charges surface par theek is tarah tarteeb lete hain ke andar kul field zero ho jati hai. Doosre lafzon mein:

blocks.title: Shielding (bachao)
blocks.text: Conductor apne andar rakhe har charge ko bahar ki electric fields se bacha leta hai.
Bahar ki fields ki madakhlat (interference) khatam karne ke liye circuits ko aksar dhaat ke dabbon mein band kiya jata hai jo aisi fields se bachate hain.
Fig. 9.19 dikhati hai ke conductor bahar ke charges ki field lines ko kaise badal deta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen + plate aur daen - plate ke darmiyan khokhla gol conductor. Us ke baen hisse par manfi aur daen hisse par musbat charges. Magenta lines baen se daen, mur kar sath se seedhe zaviye par milti hain; andar koi line nahi.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.19 (kitab ki Figure 9.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bahar ki field free electrons ko + plate wali taraf kheenchti hai, is liye conductor ki baen taraf manfi aur daen taraf musbat charge jama hota hai. Yeh charges andar ki field khatam kar dete hain, aur bahar lines surface par seedhi (perpendicular) milti hain.

Lines is liye badalti hain ke equilibrium mein conductor ki surface ke bilkul bahar field surface ke seedha (perpendicular) hoti hai. Agar field seedhi na hoti to us ka ek hissa surface ke mutawazi (parallel) hota. Surface ke free electrons hil sakte hain, is liye woh is mutawazi hisse ki force se chal parte. Magar equilibrium mein electrons ka koi bahao nahi hota. Is liye mutawazi hissa ho hi nahi sakta, aur field surface ke seedha hoti hai.

Faraday cage ke liye aisa material chahiye jis mein bohat se free electrons hon jo azaadi se surface tak ja sakein. Sirf conductors mein free electrons hote hain; insulators mein nahi hote. Is liye insulators se Faraday cage nahi banaya ja sakta.

Rozmarra zindagi mein Faraday cage ki achhi misal gari (car) hai. Toofan (thunderstorm) mein gari ka chassis aur dhaat ka dhancha andar baithe logon ko bachata hai: bijli ka charge gari ki dhaat ki surface par se guzar kar zameen mein chala jata hai aur andar musafiron tak nahi pohanchta.

Microwave oven ka dhaat ka jism bhi Faraday cage ka kaam karta hai: yeh microwaves ko oven se bahar mahaul mein phailne nahi deta. Hawai jahaz (airplane) ka dhaat ka dhancha bhi Faraday cage hai. Jab jahaz par aasmani bijli (lightning) girti hai to bijli us ke dhaat ke dhanche ki surface par phail jati hai, aur andar musafir aur saare aalaat mehfooz rehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Faraday cage kin materials se banaya ja sakta hai, aur kyun (short question 9.9)? Hawai jahaz jaisa conductor hawa mein udte hue charge kaise hasil karta hai (short question 9.1)?
blocks.explanation: Conductors se, jaise dhaatein (copper, aluminium, steel ki jaali), kyun ke un mein free electrons hote hain jo surface par ja kar tab tak tarteeb lete hain jab tak andar field zero na ho jaye; insulators mein free electrons nahi hote, is liye woh yeh kaam nahi kar sakte. Udta hua jahaz hawa, gard, pani ke qatron aur barf ke zarron se ragarta hai; yeh ragar electrons ek jagah se doosri jagah le jati hai, is liye jahaz ka jism charged ho jata hai aur charge us ki bahar wali dhaat ki surface par phail jata hai.

items: Faraday cage (1836): khokhla conductor; zaid charge surface par rehta hai aur aise tarteeb leta hai ke andar field zero ho.
Conductor ki surface ke bilkul bahar field surface ke seedha (perpendicular) hoti hai.
Sirf free electrons wale conductors se cage banta hai. Misalein: toofan mein gari, microwave oven, bijli girne par hawai jahaz, circuits ke gird dhaat ke dabbe.
